# Six level-1 characters — complete creation walkthroughs

Reconciled with the approved current catalog in the decision-conformance correction
(#1301). These are worked character choices, not new rules, random samples or combat-balance results. Every
character stops at level 1. Follow the linked sheet for both complete DP ledgers,
origin pairs, ancestry traits, signature, equipment and learned-card checklist.

| Character | Trope | Ancestry / class | HP | Speed | Bulk / capacity | L0 spent / pool | L1 spent / pool |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| [Borin Bridgekeeper](borin-bridgekeeper.md) | Stalwart guardian | Hill Dwarf Protector | 25 | 5 | 11 / 13 | 10 / 10 | 11 / 11 |
| [Lira Ashbow](lira-ashbow.md) | Woodland archer | Wood Elf Blade | 20 | 8 | 10 / 10 | 10 / 10 | 10 / 10 |
| [Pip Copperwink](pip-copperwink.md) | Burglar-duelist | Halfling Shadow | 16 | 7 | 10 / 10 | 11 / 11 | 12 / 12 |
| [Vaelis Emberglass](vaelis-emberglass.md) | Elemental scholar | Wood Elf Arcanist | 17 | 7 | 7 / 7 | 13 / 13 | 13 / 13 |
| [Mara Reedheart](mara-reedheart.md) | Grove healer / beast-shaper | Human Shepherd | 18 | 6 | 7 / 10 | 12 / 13 | 13 / 14 |
| [Oren Brass](oren-brass.md) | Investigator-tinker | Human Intellect | 17 | 6 | 9 / 10 | 13 / 14 | 15 / 16 |

Pip and Vaelis spend their full creation pools. Oren retains his listed purchases;
Adaptable leaves 1 DP to expire at each stage, as it does for Mara. Oren’s borrowed
Hill Dwarf trait is An Honest Maker’s Hand, with Dwarven as its native-language grant.
Lira’s listed Speed is 8 outside wooded terrain and 9 within it.

All start at full HP, Grit 2, no wounds and no death marks. Unspent creation DP
expires separately at each stage. Ancestry and culture are independent: Mara is a
human of Forest Communities, and Oren is a human raised in Deep Halls.

## What was checked

- All attributes are −2 through +2, total +3, and satisfy the chosen class minima.
- Each origin pair exists in its source. Only those rank-1 grants qualify level-0
  purchases; no class rank or purchased rank is borrowed from level 1.
- Every purchased card is Novice. Requirements are held before each purchase;
  class-granted disciplines are valid and distinct. Duplicate ranks yield 1 DP
  each at the correct stage, never rank 2.
- Class Home/Adjacent/Foreign prices and all running balances were checked.
- All six signatures belong to the chosen class and level. No extra signature
  purchases or advanced-tier cards are assumed.
- HP, Speed, capacity and carried Bulk were recomputed. Each item is traced to an
  explicit grant; compatible duplicate grants are counted once. Described weapons
  use the cards’ mechanics, not statistics imported from their appearance.
- Oren’s six recipe choices are distinct and compatible. Recipe knowledge does not
  supply ingredients or finished products. Other characters have no recipe grants.

These checks were run against the source Markdown with a temporary validation
script and followed by a reading of the sheets. The normal catalog audit also
passes. This checks these six builds, not every possible creation route. All
purchased disciplines here are rank 1: buying deeper ranks without access to
higher-tier cards did not serve these particular concepts.

## At the table

These examples show particular choices, not compulsory builds. Lira remains a
Blade archer; the Warden is another option for a dedicated wilderness hunter.
Pip fights with Guile, Oren with Knowledge, and Mara can heal or change form.

Borin’s weapon and shield and Lira’s bow leave no free potion hand. Equipment,
materials, coins and Bulk are recorded in each shopping ledger. Recipe knowledge
does not create supplies. Creation DP remainders expire at each stage.

These six examples do not establish comparative class strength or encounter CV.

## Starting purses and completed shopping

| Character | Starting coins | Spent | Remaining | Final Bulk / capacity |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| [Borin Bridgekeeper](borin-bridgekeeper.md) | 64 | 51 | 13 | 11/13 |
| [Lira Ashbow](lira-ashbow.md) | 58 | 44 | 14 | 10/10 |
| [Pip Copperwink](pip-copperwink.md) | 60 | 46 | 14 | 10/10 |
| [Vaelis Emberglass](vaelis-emberglass.md) | 65 | 49 | 16 | 7/7 |
| [Mara Reedheart](mara-reedheart.md) | 54 | 46 | 8 | 7/10 |
| [Oren Brass](oren-brass.md) | 66 | 56 | 10 | 9/10 |

All six remain level 1. Purchases change equipment and coin totals, not their DP ledgers or learned cards.

# Borin Bridgekeeper — level 1

*The shield-bearing guardian who brings everyone home.*

**Hill Dwarf Protector · HP 25/25 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 5 squares · Bulk 11/13.**

**Languages:** Common and Dwarven. See the [language reference](../rules/languages.md).

## Attributes and ancestry

| Brawn | Fortitude | Agility | Guile | Knowledge | Reason |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| +1 | +2 | +0 | +0 | -1 | +1 |

Total **+3**. Protector minima: Fortitude, Reason ≥ 0; met. Mental sum **+0**, so each stage’s base pool is **10 DP**.

- [Hard as Bedrock](../ancestries/trait-dwarf-deep-constitution.md): Maximum HP +1. Gain no additional resistance from this trait.
- [A Grudge Well Kept](../ancestries/trait-dwarf-carved-history.md): The first creature that deals damage to you in each combat becomes the mark of your grudge. You gain 1 Boon to attack rolls against each creature marked by your grudge. A creature remains marked forever, even if it escapes. Each creature can be marked once. You can hold any number of grudges.

The first creature to damage Borin in each combat joins his permanent grudges; he gains the attack Boon against every creature so marked.

## Level 0 — origins and purchases

- [Walled Communities](../origins/culture-walled-communities.md): **Armor 1** and [Wear Light Armor](../cards/wear-light-armor.md).
- [Household Guard](../origins/background-household-guard.md): **Arms 1** and [Hook and Drive](../cards/hook-and-drive.md).

Opening pool: **10 + 0 duplicate compensation = 10 DP**. No disciplines are purchased at this stage.

| Purchase | Requirements held / price basis | DP spent | Remaining |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Braced Harness](../cards/braced-harness.md) | Armor 1 | 2 | 8 |
| [Take Them Alive](../cards/take-them-alive.md) | Arms 1 | 2 | 6 |
| [Conditioned Body](../cards/conditioned-body.md) | None | 2 | 4 |
| [Carry the Wounded](../cards/catch-a-falling-friend.md) | None | 2 | 2 |
| [Tell a Worthy Story](../cards/tell-a-worthy-story.md) | None | 2 | 0 |

**Spent 10; 0 DP expires. Stage closes at 0.**

## Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose [Protector](../classes/protector.md). Class grants **Armor 1 and Guard 1**; 1 duplicate(s) give **+1 DP**, not higher ranks.
Free signature: [Step Between](../cards/signature-protector-between-them.md). Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** One adjacent willing ally, after a single-target attack is declared against it but before rolling.

You and the ally swap squares. You become the target of the attack and resolve it against your defense. If either of you cannot occupy the other’s square, you cannot use this reaction. This does not redirect area attacks.

**Duration:** The triggering attack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Signature limit:** Repeatable; uses your Reaction.

Fresh pool: **10 + 1 = 11 DP**. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

| Purchase | Requirements held / price basis | DP spent | Remaining |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Shielding Step](../cards/shielding-step.md) | Guard 1 | 2 | 9 |
| **Medicine 1** | Adjacent; previous rank 0 | 2 | 7 |
| [Treat Soft Tissue](../cards/treat-soft-tissue.md) | Medicine 1 | 2 | 5 |
| **Athletics 1** | Foreign; previous rank 0 | 3 | 2 |
| [Sure Ascent](../cards/sure-ascent.md) | Athletics 1 | 2 | 0 |

**Spent 11; 0 DP expires. Stage closes at 0.**

**Final disciplines:** Armor 1, Arms 1, Athletics 1, Guard 1, Medicine 1.

## Equipment and derived statistics

| Owned item and chosen appearance | Grant | Bulk |
|---|---|---:|
| Riveted light armor | [Wear Light Armor](../cards/wear-light-armor.md) | 1 |
| One-handed broad-headed hammer | [Hook and Drive](../cards/hook-and-drive.md) | 1 |
| Round shield | [Shielding Step](../cards/shielding-step.md) | 1 |

HP: 12 + ancestry 4 + class 5 + Fortitude 2 + trait 1 + Conditioned Body 1 = **25**.
Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (1) = **13**. Granted Bulk **3** + purchased Bulk **8** = **11**, so encumbrance penalty **0**. Speed: ancestry 5 + Agility 0 + trait 0 = **5**.

Physical resistance: **1 while wearing the granted light armor**. Other resistances: **0**. Wounds and death marks: **0**. Grit: **2**. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

**Recipes:** none granted or purchased.

## At the table

Hook and Drive holds a doorway; Step Between lets Borin swap squares with an ally and take a single-target attack before the roll. Taking prisoners is a deliberate use of Take Them Alive. His shield and hammer fill both hands: potions require freeing a hand. Treat Soft Tissue supplies useful care after danger, not instant scar removal.

## Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.

- [Wear Light Armor](../cards/wear-light-armor.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Hook and Drive](../cards/hook-and-drive.md) — Main Action; Brawn.
- [Braced Harness](../cards/braced-harness.md) — Reaction; Fortitude.
- [Take Them Alive](../cards/take-them-alive.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Conditioned Body](../cards/conditioned-body.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Carry the Wounded](../cards/catch-a-falling-friend.md) — Maneuver; Brawn.
- [Tell a Worthy Story](../cards/tell-a-worthy-story.md) — Main Action; Guile.
- [Shielding Step](../cards/shielding-step.md) — Reaction; None (no roll).
- [Treat Soft Tissue](../cards/treat-soft-tissue.md) — Main Action; Knowledge.
- [Sure Ascent](../cards/sure-ascent.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Step Between](../cards/signature-protector-between-them.md) — Reaction; None (no roll).

All 18 [universal cards](../catalog.md) are available without DP: Basic Melee, Basic Ranged, Basic Throw, Basic Unarmed, Force, Aid, Defend, Disengage, Stabilize, Shield Block, Opportunity Attack, Move, Stand, Handle an Item, Use a Healing Potion, Reduce a Condition, Command a Summon and Convert an Action. Their equipment and situation requirements still apply.

## Starting coins and shopping — allocation

40 + 2 + 10 + 7 + 5 (base + ancestry + culture + background + class) = **64 coins**.

One plain worn outfit is supplied by the creation baseline: 0 carried Bulk, no armor benefit. All other items below are paid for.

| Purchase | Coins | Bulk | Coins left |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| [Travel Pack](../equipment/travel-pack.md) | 3 | 1 | 61 |
| [Sleeping Roll](../equipment/sleeping-roll.md) | 4 | 1 | 57 |
| [Water Flask](../equipment/water-flask.md) | 3 | 1 | 54 |
| [Food Bundle](../equipment/food-bundle.md) | 9 | 1 | 45 |
| [Lighting Bundle](../equipment/lighting-bundle.md) | 5 | 1 | 40 |
| [Rope Coil](../equipment/rope-coil.md) | 5 | 1 | 35 |
| [Small Necessities](../equipment/small-necessities.md) | 2 | 1 | 33 |
| [Lesser Healing Bottle](../equipment/lesser-healing-bottle.md) | 20 | 1 | 13 |

**Spent 51; coins carried 13; final Bulk 11/13.** No encumbrance penalty or change to HP, Speed or Grit. The pack itself is counted. The lesser bottle is d4 and restores 6 HP per use under the normal potion action.

[Price list](../market.md) · [Starting-coin allocation](../starting-coins.md)

**Stability:** 0; no always-active Stability grant in this build. Conditional grants apply only when their cards are used.

# Lira Ashbow — level 1

*The woodland archer who reads a trail as readily as a target.*

**Wood Elf Blade · HP 20/20 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 8 squares · Bulk 10/10.**

**Languages:** Common and Elven. See the [language reference](../rules/languages.md).

## Attributes and ancestry

| Brawn | Fortitude | Agility | Guile | Knowledge | Reason |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| +0 | +1 | +2 | +0 | +1 | -1 |

Total **+3**. Blade minima: Agility, Brawn ≥ 0; met. Mental sum **+0**, so each stage’s base pool is **10 DP**.

- [Footfall on the Leaves](../ancestries/trait-elf-light-tread.md): In woodlands and forests, you ignore difficult terrain. This includes difficult terrain caused by natural terrain or obstacles, such as roots, undergrowth, fallen leaves and uneven natural ground. Your Speed increases by 1 while you are in woodlands, forests or similar wooded terrain.
- [Nature’s Whispers](../ancestries/trait-elf-leaf-listener.md): Gain 1 Boon to a roll interpreting living signs.


## Level 0 — origins and purchases

- [Forest Communities](../origins/culture-forest-communities.md): **Wilderness 1** and [Wild Harvest](../cards/forage-woodland.md).
- [Messenger](../origins/background-messenger.md): **Marksmanship 1** and [Pinning Shot](../cards/pinning-shot.md).

Opening pool: **10 + 0 duplicate compensation = 10 DP**. No disciplines are purchased at this stage.

| Purchase | Requirements held / price basis | DP spent | Remaining |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Read the Quarry](../cards/read-the-quarry.md) | Marksmanship 1 | 2 | 8 |
| [Take the Measure](../cards/take-the-measure.md) | Marksmanship 1 | 2 | 6 |
| [Roots Remember Feet](../cards/roots-remember-feet.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 4 |
| [A Good Place to Stop](../cards/a-good-place-to-stop.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 2 |
| [Guide a Frightened Animal](../cards/guide-a-frightened-animal.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 0 |

**Spent 10; 0 DP expires. Stage closes at 0.**

## Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose [Blade](../classes/blade.md). Class grants **Arms 1 and Athletics 1**; 0 duplicate(s) give **+0 DP**, not higher ranks.
Free signature: [Measured Guard](../cards/signature-blade-measured-guard.md). Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self, before a defense against an adjacent enemy.

Gain 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, if the defense was Strong and the attacker is within your reach, make a Basic Melee attack against that attacker. This counterattack is part of the Reaction and does not use your Main Action.

**Duration:** The triggering defense and immediate counterattack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Signature limit:** Repeatable; normal action economy applies.

Fresh pool: **10 + 0 = 10 DP**. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

| Purchase | Requirements held / price basis | DP spent | Remaining |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Hook and Drive](../cards/hook-and-drive.md) | Arms 1 | 2 | 8 |
| [A Knot You Can Trust](../cards/a-knot-you-can-trust.md) | Athletics 1 | 2 | 6 |
| [Sure Ascent](../cards/sure-ascent.md) | Athletics 1 | 2 | 4 |
| [Expert River Crossing](../cards/expert-river-crossing.md) | Athletics 1 | 2 | 2 |
| [Conditioned Body](../cards/conditioned-body.md) | None | 2 | 0 |

**Spent 10; 0 DP expires. Stage closes at 0.**

**Final disciplines:** Arms 1, Athletics 1, Marksmanship 1, Wilderness 1.

## Equipment and derived statistics

| Owned item and chosen appearance | Grant | Bulk |
|---|---|---:|
| Two-handed yew bow | [Pinning Shot](../cards/pinning-shot.md) | 1 |
| One d8 arrow bundle | [Pinning Shot](../cards/pinning-shot.md) | 1 |
| One-handed hunting knife | [Hook and Drive](../cards/hook-and-drive.md) | 1 |
| Rope coil | [A Knot You Can Trust](../cards/a-knot-you-can-trust.md) | 1 |

HP: 12 + ancestry 2 + class 4 + Fortitude 1 + trait 0 + Conditioned Body 1 = **20**.
Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (0) = **10**. Granted Bulk **4** + purchased Bulk **6** = **10**, so encumbrance penalty **0**. Speed: ancestry 6 + Agility 2 = **8**, or **9** in wooded terrain with Footfall on the Leaves.

Physical resistance: **0**. Other resistances: **0**. Wounds and death marks: **0**. Grit: **2**. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

**Recipes:** none granted or purchased.

## At the table

Pinning Shot uses Agility; Read the Quarry offers a Knowledge-based alternative. Take the Measure rewards staying still for the shot. Foraging, climbing and river crossing support the scout role. Measured Guard gives a defense Boon when an adjacent enemy attacks; on a Strong defense, Lira can answer with Basic Melee if the attacker remains within reach. The bow needs both hands while in use; the knife is stowed then.

## Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.

- [Wild Harvest](../cards/forage-woodland.md) — Main Action; Knowledge.
- [Pinning Shot](../cards/pinning-shot.md) — Main Action; Agility.
- [Read the Quarry](../cards/read-the-quarry.md) — Main Action; Knowledge.
- [Take the Measure](../cards/take-the-measure.md) — Maneuver; None (no roll).
- [Roots Remember Feet](../cards/roots-remember-feet.md) — Main Action; Reason.
- [A Good Place to Stop](../cards/a-good-place-to-stop.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Guide a Frightened Animal](../cards/guide-a-frightened-animal.md) — Main Action; Guile.
- [Hook and Drive](../cards/hook-and-drive.md) — Main Action; Brawn.
- [A Knot You Can Trust](../cards/a-knot-you-can-trust.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Sure Ascent](../cards/sure-ascent.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Expert River Crossing](../cards/expert-river-crossing.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Conditioned Body](../cards/conditioned-body.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [Measured Guard](../cards/signature-blade-measured-guard.md) — Reaction; None (no roll).

All 18 [universal cards](../catalog.md) are available without DP: Basic Melee, Basic Ranged, Basic Throw, Basic Unarmed, Force, Aid, Defend, Disengage, Stabilize, Shield Block, Opportunity Attack, Move, Stand, Handle an Item, Use a Healing Potion, Reduce a Condition, Command a Summon and Convert an Action. Their equipment and situation requirements still apply.

## Starting coins and shopping — allocation

40 + 2 + 5 + 7 + 4 (base + ancestry + culture + background + class) = **58 coins**.

One plain worn outfit is supplied by the creation baseline: 0 carried Bulk, no armor benefit. All other items below are paid for.

| Purchase | Coins | Bulk | Coins left |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| [Travel Pack](../equipment/travel-pack.md) | 3 | 1 | 55 |
| [Sleeping Roll](../equipment/sleeping-roll.md) | 4 | 1 | 51 |
| [Water Flask](../equipment/water-flask.md) | 3 | 1 | 48 |
| [Food Bundle](../equipment/food-bundle.md) | 9 | 1 | 39 |
| [Lighting Bundle](../equipment/lighting-bundle.md) | 5 | 1 | 34 |
| [Lesser Healing Bottle](../equipment/lesser-healing-bottle.md) | 20 | 1 | 14 |

**Spent 44; coins carried 14; final Bulk 10/10.** No encumbrance penalty or change to HP, Speed or Grit. The pack itself is counted. The lesser bottle is d4 and restores 6 HP per use under the normal potion action.

# Mara Reedheart — level 1

*The grove healer who can become the beast defending it.*

**Human Shepherd · HP 18/18 · Grit 2/2 · Speed 6 squares · Bulk 7/10.**

**Languages:** Common and Reed Speech (an ordinary regional language). See the [language reference](../rules/languages.md).

## Attributes and ancestry

| Brawn | Fortitude | Agility | Guile | Knowledge | Reason |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| +0 | +1 | +0 | +0 | +0 | +2 |

Total **+3**. Shepherd minima: Reason, Guile ≥ 0; met. Mental sum **+2**, so each stage’s base pool is **12 DP**.

- [Adaptable](../ancestries/trait-human-far-walker.md): You gain 1 additional DP at each level, including level 0.
- [Ingenuity](../ancestries/trait-human-shared-table.md): Once per scene, assemble a temporary tool, implement or weapon from nearby materials. Gain 1 Boon to the next roll using it; it lasts until the end of the scene.


## Level 0 — origins and purchases

- [Forest Communities](../origins/culture-forest-communities.md): **Wilderness 1** and [Wild Harvest](../cards/forage-woodland.md).
- [Grove Tended](../origins/background-grove-tended.md): **Life 1** and [Sap and Breath](../cards/sap-and-breath.md).

Opening pool: **12 + 1 Adaptable + 0 duplicate compensation = 13 DP**. No disciplines are purchased at this stage.

| Purchase | Requirements held / price basis | DP spent | Remaining |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Roots Remember Feet](../cards/roots-remember-feet.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 11 |
| [Borrow the Beast](../cards/borrow-the-beast.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 9 |
| [Guide a Frightened Animal](../cards/guide-a-frightened-animal.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 7 |
| [A Good Place to Stop](../cards/a-good-place-to-stop.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 5 |
| [The Otter’s Bargain](../cards/the-otter-s-bargain.md) | Wilderness 1 | 2 | 3 |
| [Keep the Door Closed](../cards/keep-the-door-closed.md) | Life 1 | 2 | 1 |

**Spent 12; 1 DP expires. Stage closes at 0.**

## Level 1 — class and purchases

Choose [Shepherd](../classes/shepherd.md). Class grants **Life 1 and Medicine 1**; 1 duplicate(s) give **+1 DP**, not higher ranks.
Free signature: [Mend](../cards/signature-shepherd-gentle-return.md). Its use procedure follows; the linked card remains the complete reference:

**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One living ally within 3 squares.

Moser's law of conservation of Life energy: pay 1 HP before rolling. This cost bypasses resistance and must leave you above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Make a Reason roll. Weak: restore 3 HP. Standard: restore 6 HP. Strong: restore 9 HP, and the target may stand without spending movement. Reduce the restored amount by the target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying creature cannot be targeted; stabilize it first. This restores no wounds and cannot reverse Last Words.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

**Signature limit:** Repeatable; normal action economy applies.

Fresh pool: **12 + 1 Adaptable + 1 = 14 DP**. All discipline purchases below occur before cards that need them.

| Purchase | Requirements held / price basis | DP spent | Remaining |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| **Radiance 1** | Home; previous rank 0 | 1 | 13 |
| [Lantern in the Palm](../cards/lantern-in-the-palm.md) | Radiance 1 | 2 | 11 |
| [Dawn Shard](../cards/dawn-shard.md) | Radiance 1 | 2 | 9 |
| [Treat Soft Tissue](../cards/treat-soft-tissue.md) | Medicine 1 | 2 | 7 |
| [Treat Bone](../cards/treat-bone.md) | Medicine 1 | 2 | 5 |
| [Relieve Poison](../cards/relieve-poison.md) | Medicine 1 | 2 | 3 |
| [Rouse the Senses](../cards/rouse-the-senses.md) | Medicine 1 | 2 | 1 |

**Spent 13; 1 DP expires. Stage closes at 0.**

**Final disciplines:** Life 1, Medicine 1, Radiance 1, Wilderness 1.

## Equipment and derived statistics

**No mechanical equipment is granted by these ability choices.** Market purchases are listed below. Ordinary appearance/clothing is descriptive; no armor, weapon, focus, tools or adventuring supplies are assumed.

HP: 12 + ancestry 2 + class 3 + Fortitude 1 + trait 0 + Conditioned Body 0 = **18**.
Capacity: 10 + 3 × Brawn (0) = **10**. Granted Bulk **0** + purchased Bulk **7** = **7**, so encumbrance penalty **0**. Speed: ancestry 6 + Agility 0 + trait 0 = **6**.

Physical resistance: **0**. Other resistances: **0**. Wounds and death marks: **0**. Grit: **2**. No HP or Grit has been spent during creation.

Starting coins and market purchases are resolved in the shopping ledger below. Card-granted equipment is not purchased again. Repeated compatible weapon/tool grants supply no duplicates.

**Recipes:** none granted or purchased.

## At the table

Sap and Breath pays 1 HP before healing 3/5/7 HP; Mara must remain above zero and have a free hand. Mend is her free signature: pay 1 HP, then restore 3/6/9 HP to one ally within 3 squares. Roots Remember Feet controls ground, while Borrow the Beast provides close fighting at the cost of spellcasting, speech and item use. Returning costs a Maneuver, so healing and beast fighting are a real choice. No potion or herb supply is silently granted.

## Complete learned-card checklist

These are all origin grants, purchases and the free signature; there is no equipped-card limit. Universal references are supplied separately.

- [Wild Harvest](../cards/forage-woodland.md) — Main Action; Knowledge.
- [Sap and Breath](../cards/sap-and-breath.md) — Main Action; Reason.
- [Roots Remember Feet](../cards/roots-remember-feet.md) — Main Action; Reason.
- [Borrow the Beast](../cards/borrow-the-beast.md) — Maneuver; None (no roll).
- [Guide a Frightened Animal](../cards/guide-a-frightened-animal.md) — Main Action; Guile.
- [A Good Place to Stop](../cards/a-good-place-to-stop.md) — Passive; None (no roll).
- [The Otter’s Bargain](../cards/the-otter-s-bargain.md) — Maneuver; None (no roll).
- [Keep the Door Closed](../cards/keep-the-door-closed.md) — Reaction; None (no roll).
- [Lantern in the Palm](../cards/lantern-in-the-palm.md) — Maneuver; None (no roll).
- [Dawn Shard](../cards/dawn-shard.md) — Main Action; Reason.
- [Treat Soft Tissue](../cards/treat-soft-tissue.md) — Main Action; Knowledge.
- [Treat Bone](../cards/treat-bone.md) — Main Action; Knowledge.
- [Relieve Poison](../cards/relieve-poison.md) — Main Action; Knowledge.
- [Rouse the Senses](../cards/rouse-the-senses.md) — Main Action; Reason.
- [Mend](../cards/signature-shepherd-gentle-return.md) — Main Action; Reason.
